['HORNBACH Holding AG & Co. KGaA '].company_description: Hornbach Baumarkt AG is a German DIY-store chain offering home improvement and do-it-yourself goods. The company operates a total of 171 DIY megastores with garden centers and online stores in nine European countries, with 96 stores located in Germany. In the 2020/2021 financial year, the company generated sales of Euro 5.1 billion.

['Nordwest Handel AG '].company_description: Nordwest Handel AG operates through four segments: the Steel segment serves a steel trading network of over 100 small and medium-sized private enterprises with centralized procurement and complementary services; Construction/Trades and Crafts/Industry offers a range of equipment and tools in areas, such as occupational health and safety, construction equipment and components, fittings and security products, work safety, power tools, hand tools, measuring tools and surface technology, precision tools, welding technology, technical trade, and workplace equipment; the Industrial Supplies segment provides a range of products, such as occupational health and safety, work safety, power tools, hand tools, measuring tools and surface technology, precision tools, welding technology, technical trade, and workplace equipment; and the Sanitary, Heating, and Air Conditioning segment offers a range of products, including plumbing and heating systems.
